notes.title: Inside the Cats...Sacks, CatSacks!
notes.notes:
Meow Wow!

Thanks to all of you, we're full of happy zoomies after the launch of CatSacks and are very excited to create this first live dev log!

With the wonderful GeekEKitten, we'll chat about how this first game came to be, run through some live game play and touch on what's next!

On Tuesday June 11th, Feel free to join us with questions or just pop by for an afternoon paws!

Thank you!

notes.title: Meow the 4th be with you!
notes.notes:
Hi All!

I'm super nervous & excited to say that there's an updated demo & fun video teaser live today [i]and[/i] that the first full chapter of CatSacks is almost here!

Please keep an eye out for an upcoming launch time special!  In the meantime, check out the fun new video trailer by GeekEKitten to celebrate & ask all your pawsome Padawan pals to wishlist 😻


~ If you run into an odd scenario where the updated demo doesn't start after Steam does it's patch magic, you may need to delete the SettingsGeneric.es3 save file in :

C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\LocalLow\CommaCrash\CatSacksDeskTop
or
%AppData%\LocalLow\CommaCrash\CatSacksDeskTop

I apologize for this weirdness & am trying to get a fix in asap this coming week.

Thank you all so much for your patience & support for my first ever game!

CommaCrash
